title: Canadian Solar SEC submissions index checked 2026-08-29
excerpt: The SEC index lists Canadian Solar's August 27, 2026 Form 6-K as its newest filing.
summary: The current SEC submissions index remains unchanged and identifies the August 27, 2026 Form 6-K furnishing Canadian Solar's second-quarter results as the issuer's newest filing through August 29. It supplies no new primary evidence explaining the sharp August 28 market move.
